help.desksBody: How lists and desks look: Action icons (View · Edit · Delete), pop-up forms, and when a side detail still appears. Also from the Help drawer (?) on any desk.

about.title: About steakOS
about.subtitle: Product line, release train, software version, and template
about.polishNote: Wave A+B platform polish ({{version}}) — setup, tour, import, help, palette
about.waveCNote: Product depth ({{version}}) — tasks, process catalogue, content rail create
about.catalogueNote: Unified catalogue master ({{version}}) — CatalogueItem sole commercial + ops master; Product/Service removed
about.goldenCodeNote: GOLDEN CODE ({{version}}) — Bronze open + entry-level Strategy/Development/Assets; trust polish; FOSS Apache-2.0
about.goldenTrunkNote: {{version}} — golden trunk. Observability L1–L2: public /api/health + ready, Prometheus /api/ops/metrics, Uptime Kuma + Grafana on Umbrel.
about.semverNote: SemVer resets per product line (SBM → SMB → …). Template ladder: Bronze → Silver → Gold. Rules: docs/versions/VERSIONS.md · History: docs/versions/CHANGELOG.md
about.licenseBody: steakOS core is free and open source software under the Apache License, Version 2.0. Copyright 2026 The steakOS Authors.
about.licenseNote: See LICENSE and NOTICE in the project repository. Optional proprietary extensions may use separate terms.
about.observabilityIntro: Local-first ops: health probes for synthetics, Prometheus metrics on this API, dashboards and uptime on Umbrel.
about.statsIntro: Live counts from this database and GORM artefacts, plus an engineering inventory snapshot (docs, LOC, tests). Disk sizes skip build/node_modules/.git.
about.closedBetaNote: Closed-beta wave ({{version}}) — builds on 0.1.6 GOLDEN; Integrations hub, Buyers/Shop Floor, Help/Ctrl+K; NDA invite-only
about.ironNote: Bronze is the team pack open for metal selection. Silver and Gold appear for orientation until those packs ship.

settings.subtitle: Company setup, template tier, locale, and admin tools.
settings.companyHint: Read-only view of legal entity, sites, banking, and template from setup.
settings.processCatalogueBlurb: Reseed read-only SYSTEM processes (PO, quote→order, invoice, delivery, inquiry, hire, project, HITL) for this tenant. Does not modify HUMAN / AGENTIC / OTHER processes.
settings.reseededDetail: Reseeded: +{{created}} created, {{updated}} updated, {{steps}} steps ({{catalogSize}} in catalog)
settings.adminBlurb: Wizard is one-shot for normal use. Admins may re-open it for demos (full reset). Prefer editing LegalEntity / settings via domain tools when you only need small changes.
settings.wipeSeed: Wipe seed identity (LegalEntity, Sites, BankAccounts, CompanySettings)

settings.resetNeedsTotp: Authenticator code required. Open /totp, enter a code, return here, and confirm reset again.
settings.resetStillComplete: Reset did not reopen setup — server still reports setup complete.
settings.hermesBlurb: Mint opaque bearer tokens for logical Hermes agents on olympus. Each agent is a steakOS user (e.g. HiveA:bookkeeper). Telegram/BBQbot is not a steakOS user — it runs on Hermes only.
settings.tokenOnce: Copy this token now — it will not be shown again:
settings.confirmRevoke: Revoke this agent token? Hermes will get 401 until a new token is minted.
settings.hermesDocHint: Activate once: docs/installation/ACTIVATE-AGENT.md · deep profile: HERMES-PROFILE.md · Help: Activate agent (API)
settings.activationChecklistBlurb: Agent Basics: mint a token here, paste into your operator-owned agent host, prove a read, optionally propose for HITL. Agents do not settle money by default.
settings.btcCeoAck: CEO acknowledges training for this upgrade (required)
settings.btcWarnL2: Security notice (Level 2): single software-wallet address for occasional payments only. steakOS does not hold your keys.
settings.integrationsHubHint: Nostr, Bitcoin receive, and Hermes tokens live under System → Integrations.
settings.hermesHint: Mint opaque sos_… tokens for operator-owned agent hosts. Shown once.
settings.hermesMinted: Copy this token now — it will not be shown again.
settings.btcHint: How this company receives Bitcoin. Separate from primary value rail.
settings.btcLevel2WarnBody: You are receiving Bitcoin to a single software-wallet address. This is meant for occasional payments only. Address reuse, device malware, and weak backups can cause permanent loss. steakOS does not hold your keys. Complete advanced Bitcoin security training, and plan to upgrade to BTCPay Server (Level 3) for regular Lightning / on-chain receive.
settings.btcLevelHint: How this company receives Bitcoin. Separate from primary value rail. Lightning marketing only at Level 3 (BTCPay).
settings.currenciesWeUseHint: Short list for dropdowns. Company currency stays enabled. Enable a code before writing it on partners, catalogue, or documents.
settings.demoBlurb: Each demo is isolated from your live company. Reset only wipes that demo’s showcase data.
settings.demoConfirmResetOrange: Reset Orange Steak House demo data? Live company and Heard & Cook are not touched.
settings.demoHeardBlurb: Indian Rocks Beach, FL — residential/commercial design, plan DVDs, kitchen studio.
settings.demoConfirmResetHeard: Reset Heard & Cook Architects demo data? Live company and Orange Steak House are not touched.
settings.taxCodesWeUseHint: Short list for Sales / PO tax pickers. Default code stays enabled when VAT is on. Kleinunternehmer / None suppresses VAT on sales docs.
settings.depthBlurb: Sales and Finance run at Advanced depth on Silver (pack-mandatory). Not toggled back to Basics here.
settings.messagingBlurb: Optional outbound messaging. Leave off until you add credentials under System → Integrations.
settings.packOptionsBlurb: Sales and Finance Advanced depth is pack-mandatory. Messaging stays off until you enable it and add credentials under Integrations.
settings.templateUpgradeBlurb: Current metal and open packs. Upgrading to Silver adds Governance and Stakeholder desks, Sales/Finance Advanced depth, and optional email/Telegram. Existing data stays.

settings.templateUpgradeConfirmBody: Adds Governance and Stakeholder desks, Sales/Finance Advanced depth, and optional email/Telegram (off by default). Existing Bronze data stays.

security.totpStep1: 1. Install Google Authenticator, Aegis, or similar.
security.totpStep2: 2. Scan this QR (or enter the key manually):
security.totpStep3: 3. Enter the 6-digit code from the app

security.extensionBlurb: Install Alby (or another NIP-07 extension), unlock it, then link here while signed in with your password. After Linked = Yes, use “Sign in with browser extension” on the login page. Never paste a secret key (nsec).

security.extensionLinked: Browser extension linked. You can use “Sign in with browser extension” next time.
